summaryForNext: Both changes archived; 9 capabilities live (added hooks/dispatch and refiner/qa-gate). 220 tests, 219 pass, 0 fail, 1 skipped; constraints 10/10; specs 9/9; CI 17 green of 20. ALL 6 DELIVERY GOALS MET, 2 PROCESS GOALS PARTIAL. Cold start on windows-latest: worst sample 64.1ms = 6.4% of the 1000ms budget, ~15x headroom, all THREE 1s hooks measured (goals.md named two; porting precompact-kbd-control brought a third under the same budget). THE DELTA THAT MATTERS: 6 of 8 CRITICALs were defects in my TESTS or CLAIMS, not my code. I asserted 'mutation testing on every section' while the rewritten fetch probe -- the central change of the Windows review -- was executed ZERO times by the suite; making it throw left everything green. Six further tests guarded on `if (!existsSync) return`, passing vacuously when their subject was deleted. SECOND DELTA: I fixed a bug in one file and did not look elsewhere, three times. The concatenated file:// URL guard was caught by CI in hooks.test.mjs, then by review in hook-entry.mjs, then by review again in FOUR carried files. Corrective action 2 addresses it: search the tree for the pattern before fixing the instance. THIRD DELTA: three tasks named a path that did not resolve when the task ran (execution.md, 'upstream submodule', task 3.3 editing a file task 5.1 carries). Corrective action 4 is a plan-time check. WHAT IMPROVED vs platform-foundation: the 2-round cap held for the first time (0 changes reached round 3, was 4 of 6); the gate substitution for change 1 was declared IN ADVANCE rather than discovered at reflection, which is the Delta 2 correction; and I caught two of my own evidence errors before review did. SYCOPHANCY GATE: analyze_reflect_phase (strict, the binary) scored 0.018 against a 0.4 threshold, S-08 not detected. One S-07 Low flag on length, kept and recorded rather than trimmed. BLOCKING FOR THE OPERATOR: corrective action 3 -- a liter-llm gateway credential. All 10 review rounds this phase were same-model-family because the gateway answers /health 200 but rejects every API call for a missing Authorization header. Critic isolation held and the judges found 8 real CRITICALs, but cross_model_check is NOT verified-distinct for a single artifact this phase. Highest-value single fix available. RECOMMENDED NEXT PHASE: karpathy-logs-node -- consumes lib/platform/ and the hook lifecycle this phase built, and is where the OKF v0.2 log bundle and the three log tiers land.
